[Intro: one clean guitar note, long reverb, birds]

[Section A: clean guitar figure, bass answers]

[Section B: wordless voices enter, soft and low]
Ooh, ah
Ooh, ah

[Build: kick and rim click enter, guitar doubles]
Ooh, ah
(Ooh)

[Section C: full pattern, second guitar harmony]

producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 100 BPM, 4/4, A minor. Sparse, cool and expectant, with a slow steady pulse.

VOICE: No words. A man and a woman sing soft, low 'ooh' and 'ah' notes in unison and then a third apart, very quietly, as another instrument. No lead vocal.

INSTRUMENTS: A clean electric guitar with reverb playing a five-note figure, a second guitar harmonising later, a deep, plain bass guitar answering in the gaps, a soft kick and rim click from the build, a single handclap on four, a faint synth pad, morning birds and one splash.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, one note and birds. 0:10 Section A, guitar and bass. 0:34 Section B, voices. 0:58 Build, drums in. 1:20 Section C, full pattern. 1:44 Break, guitar alone. 1:54 Final section. 2:18 Outro, last note and the splash at 2:26.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Minimal and dry with one long reverb: every sound separate and clear, a lot of silence, bass deep and soft.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The single splash at 2:26, the only loud thing in the piece.

STATION FIT: 7 a.m., the station's first track of the day and a natural ident bed. Short, instrumental and calm.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Still, waiting, gathering, begun.
